why: Final decision: the stuffed-animal cage is visible in the downward camera at the bottom-right of frame, slightly off-center from our position. The policy wants to move 0.3-0.4m further away and add a 65deg turn, which would carry us away from the target based on every previous large move this flight. Overriding with a small centering nudge (back/right, no yaw, no altitude change) to end the flight as close to directly overhead the stuffed animal as possible, since this is the last decision and holding position over the target matters more than chasing the policy's plan.
